description: Builds company- and persona-specific hands-on labs that take participants from an empty Fabric workspace to a published Microsoft Fabric data agent: prerequisites, click-path steps, copy-ready agent and data source instructions, validated example SQL, test prompts with computed answers, synthetic CSV data, and a scheduled PySpark ingestion notebook. Use when the user asks to "create a Fabric data agent exercise", "build a Fabric Data Agent workshop", "build a Fabric data agent lab", or "data agent hands-on for [company]". Do NOT use for Copilot Cowork exercises (copilot-cowork-exercise-builder), Copilot Studio agents (copilot-studio-exercise-builder), other Copilot surfaces (copilot-exercise-builder), HTML formatting alone (copilot-exercise-html-formatter), or provisioning real Fabric items.
